title: Bar Drop Malaysian Mango 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Malaysian Mango offers a deeply authentic and exotic tropical fruit experience. The profile focuses entirely on the rich, syrupy sweetness of ripe Mango, capturing its distinctive aromatic notes and juicy character. The extra-concentrated recipe elevates the natural sweetness of the fruit, ensuring the tropical mango flavour remains intensely vivid and highly satisfying from start to finish. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is specifically designed for MTL/RDL vaping. When paired with stater vape kits and low-wattage tanks, it produces small vapour clouds alongside exceptional flavour clarity. The even consistency ensures optimal wicking and performance in MTL/RDL devices, providing a smooth and satisfying experience. The Bar Drop Shortfill collection takes the intensely concentrated flavour profiles typically found in "bar salt" ranges and presents them in a 50%-VG format. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there is space to add a single 10ml nicotine shot, allowing you to easily create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This offers a cost-effective and highly flavoursome solution for sub-ohm vapers.
